title: Thinking Companies
limitations: Practitioner essay and commercial positioning statement by the founder of The Thinking Company and Runstate. Argues that AI enables continuous operational re-examination of stale process assumptions and unbundles the job bundle, while synthesizing the AI-native services model (Julien Bek, Bérenger Teboul-Danguin, Jake Saper). The supply-chain case is an illustrative scenario rather than an independently verified enterprise case study; claims of reaching Big Four consulting scale with minimal headcount remain unverified venture forecasts.
